purpose: Executable mask contract for the BCSS native-22 to unified remap.

constraints.mask_statement: Preserve every unified-zero pixel exactly; outside-ROI, excluded, and undetermined pixels cannot seed, receive, connect, or be crossed by an edit.
generation_handoff: Do not inpaint protected zero pixels.
known_limitations: The collapsed mask cannot recover which native zero concept produced each pixel.

constraints.mask_statement: Require the preprocessing revision and original label-map digest before interpreting any unified ID.
known_limitations: Presence of a digest is not yet cryptographic verification against a certified manifest.

constraints.mask_statement: Enforce the declared source-to-target fine-ID transition and preserve DCIS, angioinvasion, vessels, immune regions, normal epithelium, necrosis, and Other tissue unless explicitly requested.
generation_handoff: Retain the visible identity of protected fine-label regions.
known_limitations: Many-to-one canonical labels cannot recover native subtype identity.

constraints.mask_statement: Do not delete small minority-label components, fill holes, merge components, or smooth across protected labels as generic cleanup.
known_limitations: Certified dataset statistics are still required to distinguish annotation noise from rare true components outside mask edit.
